registries.name: Indian Patent Office (Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks)
registries.action: File a patent application, then request its examination
registries.cite_quote: shall be made in the prescribed form and filed in the patent office

forms.name: Form 18
forms.quote: A request for examination under section 11B shall be made in Form 18

forms.name: Form 1
forms.purpose: Application corresponding to an international (PCT) application
forms.quote: may be made in Form 1 under sub-section (1A) of section 7

registries.forms_note: The form for an ordinary application is 'the prescribed form' in s.7; the forms schedule of the Patents Rules is not in the corpus, so verify it before filing.
registries.fee_note: Fees are set by the Patents Rules, 2003 (as amended in 2024); not quoted here.

registries.name: Geographical Indications Registry
registries.action: Apply to register a geographical indication for a class of goods
registries.cite_quote: shall apply in writing to the Registrar

forms.name: Form GI-1
forms.purpose: Application to register a geographical indication
forms.quote: shall be made in Form GI-1

registries.fee_note: Fees are set by the Geographical Indications Rules, 2002; not quoted here.

registries.name: Trade Marks Registry
registries.action: Apply to register a trade mark for your goods or services
registries.cite_quote: shall apply in writing to the Registrar in the prescribed manner
registries.forms_note: The Trade Marks Rules, which name the forms, are not in the corpus: the e-filing portal shows the current form.

registries.name: National Biodiversity Authority
registries.action: Seek approval before accessing a biological resource or associated knowledge
registries.cite_quote: shall make an application on the web portal of the Authority in Form 1

forms.name: Form 1
forms.purpose: Access for research, bio-survey or bio-utilisation
forms.quote: for research or for bio-survey and bio-utilisation shall make an application on the web portal of the Authority in Form 1

forms.name: Form 2
forms.quote: for commercial utilisation shall make an application on the web portal of the Authority in Form 2

registries.fee_note: Fees are in the First Schedule to the Biological Diversity Rules, 2024.

registries.name: State Licensing Authority for Ayurveda, Siddha and Unani drugs (e-Aushadhi)
registries.action: Apply for a licence to manufacture Ayurvedic, Siddha or Unani drugs for sale
registries.cite_quote: shall be made in Form 24-D to the Licensing Authority

forms.name: Form 24-D
forms.purpose: Licence to manufacture Ayurvedic (including Siddha) or Unani drugs for sale
forms.quote: shall be made in Form 24-D to the Licensing Authority

registries.name: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FoSCoS)
registries.action: Get a food business licence or registration before selling Ayurveda Aahara
registries.cite_quote: No person shall commence or carry on any food business except under a licence
registries.forms_note: The licensing regulations that name the forms are not in the corpus; FoSCoS shows which licence or registration applies.

registries.name: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Authority
registries.action: Register a new, extant or farmers' plant variety
registries.cite_quote: may make an application to the Registrar for registration of any variety
registries.forms_note: The PPV&FR Rules, which name the application form, are not in the corpus; the Authority's site has the current one.

registries.name: Microbial Type Culture Collection and Gene Bank (MTCC), a depositary authority
registries.action: Deposit a micro-organism a patent application relies on, before filing
registries.cite_quote: an international depository authority under the Budapest Treaty

forms.name: Recognised depositary
forms.purpose: MTCC is on WIPO's list of International Depositary Authorities (since 4 October 2002); MCC and NAIMCC are the other two in India
forms.quote: Microbial Type Culture Collection and Gene Bank (MTCC)

registries.forms_note: Each depositary sets its own deposit forms and charges; ask it directly.
